Class ScenarioDefaultValueManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioDefaultValueManager
public final class ScenarioDefaultValueManager extends Object
Utility managing default value annotations, tooltips, right-click reset context menus, and change-highlighting styling across scenario setup UI controls.

  • Method Details

    • attachDefaultValueHandling

      public static <T> void attachDefaultValueHandling(javafx.scene.control.Control control, T defaultValue, Runnable resetAction, Runnable onParamChange)
      Attaches default value handling to a JavaFX control:
      1. Appends "[DEFAULT VALUE: X]" to the tooltip.
      2. Adds a right-click Context Menu ("Reset to default value (X)").
      Type Parameters:
      T - value type
      Parameters:
      control - target UI control
      defaultValue - default reference value
      resetAction - callback to reset control to default
      onParamChange - callback invoked when value changes

    • highlightControlIfModified

      public static void highlightControlIfModified(javafx.scene.control.Control control, boolean isModified)
      Highlights or clears modified visual border styling on a JavaFX control.
      Parameters:
      control - target control
      isModified - whether current value diverges from default

    • getTypeBParamDefault

      public static double getTypeBParamDefault(String engineKey, String paramKey)
      Resolves the canonical default parameter value for Type B optional cliodynamic engines.
      Parameters:
      engineKey - unique class or identifier of the engine
      paramKey - parameter identifier
      Returns:
      canonical default floating-point value
